Diallo Confirms Bid to Challenge Infantino for FIFA Presidency

French soccer leader Philippe Diallo has confirmed his bid to challenge Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency. UEFA has backed Diallo's candidacy. Separately, Japan's Tashima has also submitted a bid for the FIFA presidency.
